QuestInfo.name: Destroying the Barrier
QuestInfo.0: Fujihawk looked over all the scrolls. Ask Fuji if he figured out how to dispel the magic.
QuestInfo.1: You need to gather #e#b70 #t4000702##n#k to remove the barrier to the Daimyo's Chambers. Gather the items and bring them to the door.
QuestInfo.2: You need to gather #e#b70 #t4000702##n#k to remove the barrier to the Daimyo's Chambers. Gather the items and bring them to the door.\nYou did so and removed the barrier.

0.0: Fujihawk has figured it out! The scrolls revealed that the Broken Tatemono on the Sakura Samurai helmets contains the power of the moon, which can dispel the Gigatoad's corrupt poisons! Will you help gather some?

yes.0: You can find Sakura Samurai near the Daimyo's Chambers on the 5th floor of the Castle Tower. Fujihawk and I simply cannot believe that the Gigatoad left all the keys to his demise in this very tower! What a buffoon! Now, get #b#e70 #t4000702##k#n!

no.0: Please, you're going to make Fujihawk cry.

1.0: #b(The Gigatoad's barrier glows faintly in front of you. You place the #t4000702# near the barrier. There's a faint shimmer, then the barrier disappears.)

yes.0: #b(You should be able to open the door now.)#k
